svg.title: AST matching still runs after token collection
svg.desc: Direct tidy matching moves to the listener; afterExecute reaches its deferred consumer. Token finalization, traversal restriction and the afterExecute hook loop remain unchanged in ParsedAST. run() executes and releases the delegate while the listener's MatchFinder is still alive.
svg.text: AST matching still runs after token collection
Direct tidy matching moves to the listener; afterExecute reaches its deferred consumer.

Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
